'SpectralA909.actual_ideal_theta_seminorm_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SpectralA909.actual_ideal_theta_seminorm_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
SpectralA909.actual_ideal_theta_seminorm_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
  ∃ C,
    0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (f : 𝓢(mixedSpace K, ℂ)),
        ‖∑' (x : ↥(idealLattice K I)), f ↑x‖ ≤
          C * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) f + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (finrank ℤ ↥(idealLattice K I) + 1) 0) f)
